title: Geometrically Constrained and Token-Based Probabilistic Spatial Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2509.11218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatial transformations such as rotation and scale obscure the morphological cues needed for accurate image classification. Careful consideration is required for reliable use in high stakes settings. A model should stay robust under such transformations, expose why a correction was applied, and signal when its input is ambiguous. While geometrically equivariant architectures provide a mathematically grounded solution, they often limit model flexibility through strict symmetry constraints and incur significant computational overhead. Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) offer a data-driven, flexible alternative for learning pseudo-equivariances to affine transformations. However, STNs have historically been restricted to convolutional architectures and suffer from training instability. To address this, we introduce a novel STN framework. It leverages the global modeling capabilities of transformers to regress the affine transform

translated_title: 几何约束与基于标记的概率空间变换器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.11218v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：旋转和缩放等空间变换会模糊图像分类所需的形态学线索。在高风险场景中可靠使用需要仔细考量。模型应在此类变换下保持鲁棒性，解释为何应用校正，并在输入模糊时发出信号。虽然几何等变架构提供了数学上扎实的解决方案，但它们常通过严格的对称约束限制模型灵活性，并产生显著的计算开销。空间变换网络（STNs）提供了一种数据驱动的灵活替代方案，用于学习仿射变换的伪等变性。然而，STNs历来受限于卷积架构，并存在训练不稳定性问题。为解决此问题，我们引入了一种新型STN框架，利用变换器的全局建模能力来回归仿射变换。
tldr: 本文提出一种新型空间变换网络框架，利用变换器的全局建模能力回归仿射变换，克服传统STN的训练不稳定性和卷积架构限制，同时保持几何变换下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel Spatial Transformer Network framework that leverages transformers' global modeling capabilities to regress affine transformations, overcoming traditional STN's training instability and convolutional architecture limitations while maintaining robustness under geometric transformations.
